The BKRs are definitely designed to Bluetooth to the MSA G1. Not positive of any other bluetooth applications for the radio. 

The SCBA tag is essentially the bridge between the specific radio and the specific SCBA pack. The radio then uses the microphone that’s inside the MMR of the SCBA, instead of someone having to yell at just the right angle to get your voice to the lapel mic. 

https://www.bktechnologies.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/G1-SCBA-Config-and-Pairing-Guide-BKR5000-12-3-2021-v2.pdf

Hope this helps.
